title: Iran warns US against military actions in region
summary: Iran's Defense Minister, Brigadier General Hossein Dehghan, warned the US on Tuesday that any 'adventurous' moves would be met with a strong response. The warning came as tensions between Iran and the US continued to simmer across the region. Iran has been engaged in talks with Pakistan and Turkey over regional security issues. The US has been critical of Iran's nuclear program and has imposed sanctions on the country. Iran has threatened to retaliate against any US military action in the region.
